program:
app "Gully" ball plum
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, wide bool
setting over bool = yes "Over by"
let n = count(ball today where wide = no)
grid 2 gap 1
  each 1..6 as k
    if count(ball today where wide = k) > 0
      box pad 3 radius 12 fill good tap remove last(ball today where wide = yes)
        "W" k bold

      box pad 3 radius 12 fill soft tap remove last(ball today where wide = yes)
        "O" count(ball today where wide = yes) faint
row gap 2
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    button it tap add ball runs = it
row gap 2
  button "Wide" tap add ball wide = yes
  button "Over" fill bad tap add ball wide = yes
button "Undo" tap remove last(ball today)
